article.headline: No. 21 Louisville meets Pittsburgh in ACC play

article.title: No. 21 Louisville meets Pittsburgh in ACC play
article.linkText: No. 21 Louisville meets Pittsburgh in ACC play
article.story: Pittsburgh (6-4) at No. 21 Louisville (7-3), Nov. 21 at 7:30 p.m. EST. Opening Line: Louisville by 13.5. Against the spread: Louisville 6-4, Pittsburgh 5-5. How to watch: ESPN2 Key stats Louisville Offense Overall: 469.5 yards per game (12th in FBS) Passing: 249.5 yards per game (37th) Rushing: 220 yards per game (12th) Scoring: 38.3 points per game (12th) Louisville Defense Overall: 393.3 yards per game (106th in FBS) Passing: 257.2 yards per game (129th) Rushing: 136.1 yards per game (56th) Scoring: 24.7 points per game (70th) Pittsburgh Offense Overall: 432.1 yards per game (27th in FBS) Passing: 266.3 yards per game (22nd) Rushing: 165.8 yards per game (54th) Scoring: 29.7 points per game (54th) Pittsburgh Defense Overall: 314.6 yards per game (27th in FBS) Passing: 243.6 yards per game (119th) Rushing: 71 yards per game (2nd) Scoring: 19.4 points per game (28th) Louisville is 25th in FBS in defensive third down percentage, allowing opponents to convert on 32.7% of third downs. Louisville is 8th in the FBS with a +9 turnover margin. Both teams are heavily penalized. Louisville ranks 126th in the FBS averaging 72.4 penalty yards per game, and Pittsburgh ranks 131st with a 78.1-yard average. Louisville is 69th in FBS in red zone offense, scoring on 85% of trips. Pittsburgh's red zone defense ranks 15th at 74.2%. Louisville ranks 95th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 29:13, compared to Pittsburgh's 44th-ranked average of 31:06. Team leaders Louisville Passing: Lincoln Kienholz, 2,430 yards, 15 TDs, 3 INTs, 68.6 completion percentage Rushing: Isaac Brown, 804 yards on 111 carries, 8 TDs Receiving: Tre Richardson, 708 yards on 50 catches, 3 TDs Pittsburgh Passing: Mason Heintschel, 1,304 yards, 14 TDs, 1 INT, 66.2 completion percentage Rushing: Damon Ferguson Jr., 694 yards on 130 carries, 6 TDs Receiving: Cataurus Hicks, 730 yards on 37 catches, 6 TDs Last game Louisville defeated North Carolina 16-14 on Nov. 14. Kienholz led Louisville with 154 yards on 23-of-31 passing (74.2%) for one touchdown and no interceptions. Keyjuan Brown carried the ball 11 times for 78 yards, adding one reception for six yards. Lawayne McCoy recorded 64 yards on six catches. Pittsburgh was beaten by Florida State 16-10 on Nov. 13. Corey Dailey led Pittsburgh with 157 yards on 16-of-34 passing (47.1%) for one touchdown and one interception. He also carried the ball nine times for 58 yards. Ja'Kyrian Turner had 42 rushing yards on 12 carries, adding seven receptions for 41 yards and one touchdown. Malik Knight recorded 55 yards on three catches. Next game Louisville plays at No. 17 Kentucky on Nov. 28. Pittsburgh plays at Cal on Nov. 28.
